reason: The lines show the function reads commit metadata and patch diffs from a Git repository for a caller-supplied revision and returns them. That establishes SECRET because repository contents/history may be non-public host/user data exposed into the agent context. It establishes UNTRUSTED because commit messages, paths, authors, and diffs are repository content and can be attacker-controlled. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution; GitPython operations/diff generation are used, but not arbitrary command execution from these lines alone. They also do not show sending agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination, only returning a string result, so SINK is not supported.
